title: SkillsFuture Singapore: fixing erroneous SME training grants and investigating training providers for gaming
asked: Two MPs asked about the Auditor-General's findings on then-SkillsFuture Singapore: whether the erroneous Enhanced Training Support for SME disbursements are being rectified and whether affected businesses or individuals will be harmed, and whether police reports have been filed over training providers potentially gaming course fee funding and whether grants will be recovered.
asked_by: Mr Vikram Nair and Mr Fadli Fawzi
response: SWDA has fixed the IT system logic that misclassified firms as SMEs and revised its operating procedures for SME eligibility assessments. It is investigating training providers and trainees for potential gaming, will make police reports if criminal behaviour is indicated, and will recover grants where warranted. Of the $4.32 million disbursed under ETSS, about $2.24 million was over-disbursed, but $2.08 million of that would have been payable anyway under the SkillsFuture Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy scheme. There will be no adverse impact on the businesses or individuals who received disbursements based on the prior assessments.

key_points.point: SWDA has corrected the IT system logic that wrongly classified firms as SMEs and revised its operating procedures for future SME eligibility checks.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: SWDA has rectified the erroneous system logic in the information technology (IT) system that led to the misclassification of firms as small and medium enterprises (SMEs).

key_points.point: Businesses and individuals who received the disbursements will not be adversely affected.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: There will be no adverse impact on the businesses or individuals who received disbursements based on the prior assessments.

key_points.point: The Ministry will honour disbursements that supported real training benefiting local workers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: The Ministry will honour the disbursements which were used to support real training that benefited local workers.

key_points.point: SWDA is investigating training providers and trainees for potential gaming behaviour.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: SWDA is currently investigating training providers and trainees involved in potential gaming behaviour.

key_points.point: Police reports will be made if investigations indicate possible criminal behaviour.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: If ongoing investigations indicate that any criminal behaviour might be involved, Police reports will be made.

key_points.point: Grants will be recovered where warranted if investigations confirm a breach of funding terms or other inappropriate conduct.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: We will take appropriate action, including recovering grants where warranted, if investigations confirm a breach of funding terms or other inappropriate conduct.

key_points.point: Total ETSS grant disbursed to affected companies was $4.32 million, of which about $2.24 million was over-disbursed.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: The total ETSS grant amount disbursed to the affected companies was $4.32 million, but the amount that was over-disbursed was about $2.24 million.

key_points.point: $2.08 million of the affected companies' grants would have been payable under the SkillsFuture Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy scheme, which gives a 20% course fee subsidy to Singapore Citizens aged 40 and above.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: a number of these affected companies would otherwise have been eligible for grants totaling $2.08 million under the SkillsFuture Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy scheme

key_points.point: SWDA will enhance detection and investigation of different types of gaming behaviour and adjust funding policies where necessary.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: over time, SWDA will enhance its efforts to detect and investigate different types of gaming behaviours
